# Sample Manifesto

A short Booklet, Built only to Exercise the Converter.

> Every Rule Earns its Place by Surviving Contact with real Text.
> This File is that Contact.

## One · First Rule

A Paragraph Reads as Prose, Justified against both Margins, wrapping
across as many Lines as the Page Allows before the next Block Begins.

1. The First Item Counts.
2. The Second Item Counts too.
3. Three Items Round the List off.

| Receive | Transform | Return |
|---|---|---|
| Read the Input | Shape the Value | Hand it Back |

> **Callout**
>
> A Quote that Opens on a bold Word Becomes a labeled Box instead of
> a plain Quote.

> A Quote with no bold Opening Stays a plain Quote, bordered on the Left.

```go
func SumItemPrices(items []Item) int {
 total := 0
 for _, it := range items {
  total += it.Price * it.Qty
 }
 return total
}
```

## Two · Second Rule

A second Section Proves the Index Splits on every Heading, not only
the first one.

*This last Line Closes the Booklet, and it Closes in Italics.*
